name: Bill.com
summary: Accounts-payable and receivable automation for finance teams with real approval chains.
best_for: growing companies with real accounts-payable volume and approval chains that want to automate bill pay and sync to accounting
skip_if: you pay only a few bills a month — your accounting software or a free tool like Melio's base plan covers it without per-seat fees
honest_knock: Per-user pricing plus per-transaction fees means the real cost depends on team size and payment volume — it's built for finance teams with genuine AP workflows and is overkill if you pay a handful of bills a month.

plans.name: Spend and Expense
plans.includes: Credit lines $1,000-$5M, not guaranteed, set on approval

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-15 on their own pricing page) Accounts-payable and receivable plans priced per user: Essentials $49, Team $65 and Corporate $89 per user per month, plus a quote-only Enterprise - the same four cards as on 15 August 2026. The separate Spend and Expense product is $0 per user per month and carries credit lines the page advertises as $1,000-$5M, not guaranteed and set on approval. Transaction fees stack on top of the seat, and are where the real cost hides. ACH or ePayment is $0.59, a mailed check $1.99, an international USD wire $19.99, and an international FX wire or a virtual card is free - free of a stated fee, that is, because the same row says the exchange rate applies and BILL only discloses that rate at the time of the transaction. Instant payment is 1.0% with a $9.99 minimum and a $100 maximum, and Pay Faster ACH $11.99. Expedited checks are $24.99 overnight, $19.99 two-day and $14.99 three-day. Paying by card costs 2.9%, and the receiver pays 2.9% on credit or debit card payments; a receiver taking an instant transfer pays 1% to 1.49% with a $1 minimum. A second fee block, easy to miss under the payment table, prices the paperwork and the mistakes: 1099 e-filing to the IRS is $2.99 per form ($1.99 through an accountant console), state filing $1.49 and mailing a 1099 to the vendor $1.99, while voiding a check is $25, a returned check $3, a re-debit after failed funding $25 and an ACH that fails after the receiver has been paid $50. The accountant side is priced separately again: a BILL AP & AR Partner subscription at $49 a month, an Accountant Console the FAQ also prices at $49 a month, and a 10-20% client subscription discount that scales with how many clients you onboard.
